scripts.Tests: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report.zip') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; npx.cmd playwright test; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Compress-Archive -Path 'playwright-report\*' -DestinationPath 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; exit $code"
scripts.Tests:test-uae: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (-not $env:ORCHESTRATOR_ARTIFACT_DIR -and -not $env:ORCHESTRATOR_PATH) { throw 'ORCHESTRATOR_ARTIFACT_DIR or ORCHESTRATOR_PATH must be supplied externally' }; $env:ORCHESTRATOR_ENV='test-uae'; npm.cmd run Tests; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
scripts.smoke: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report.zip') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; npx.cmd playwright test --grep '@smoke'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Compress-Archive -Path 'playwright-report\*' -DestinationPath 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; exit $code"
scripts.smoke:test-uae: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (-not $env:ORCHESTRATOR_ARTIFACT_DIR -and -not $env:ORCHESTRATOR_PATH) { throw 'ORCHESTRATOR_ARTIFACT_DIR or ORCHESTRATOR_PATH must be supplied externally' }; $env:ORCHESTRATOR_ENV='test-uae'; npm.cmd run smoke; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
scripts.sanity: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report.zip') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; npx.cmd playwright test --grep '@sanity'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Compress-Archive -Path 'playwright-report\*' -DestinationPath 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; exit $code"
scripts.regression: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report.zip') { Remove-Item 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; $p='@smoke'+[char]124+'@sanity'; node .\node_modules\playwright\cli.js test --grep-invert $p; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if (Test-Path 'playwright-report') { Compress-Archive -Path 'playwright-report\*' -DestinationPath 'playwright-report.zip' -Force }; exit $code"
